description:
Warhammer Academy is the essential online resource for anyone who wants to build confidence in their Warhammer skills – and the site is now live.

The Academy is a perfect jumping-on point for those new to the hobby, or anyone coming back to it after a short break, so if you’ve got a mate that has been wanting to get involved but isn’t sure where to start, this is the place to send them. https://ow.ly/Tb3f50ZqA1w

Find out more: Warhammer-Community.com
Get started for FREE: Academy.Warhammer.com

Follow for more Warhammer, more often:

- Sign up for Warhammer+: https://www.warhammerplus.com/
- Warhammer 40,000 on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@OfficialWarhammer40000
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/warhammerofficial/
- Threads: https://www.threads.net/@warhammerofficial
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/WarhammerOfficial/
- Warhammer Community: https://www.warhammer-community.com/
- Get Warhammer in your inbox: https://ow.ly/6SJq50T3NL1"
